1b346c0a0f5985f257ad7dcc7e5c1ecffb44a339.summary: Trend Micro threat encyclopedia entry for Ransom.Win32.WHITERABBIT.YACAET, described as ransomware. It arrives as a file dropped by other malware or downloaded unknowingly from malicious sites, drops ransom note files, and avoids encrypting files with certain extensions. The page gives remediation steps: Trend Micro products detect it, users should disable System Restore before scanning, delete the listed files, and restore encrypted files from backup. The page was archived on 2026-11-25.
